gaps.current_state: V3 knowledge (claims, evidence, projection) is derived exclusively from code discovery (V1/V2 extraction and resolution).
gaps.gap: No domain model or ingestion path exists for HUMAN_REQUIREMENT, USER_STORY, BUSINESS_REQUIREMENT, BUSINESS_CONTEXT, TECHNICAL_CONSTRAINT, CORPORATE_STANDARD, APPROVED_DECISION, EXTERNAL_DOCUMENT, or PROJECT_DOCUMENT source types listed in V4_CONTRACT_FOUNDATION section 4.

gaps.current_state: The only human input V3 accepts is a fixed set of Markdown disposition records for a closed round (human_review.py, second_review.py), with a hardcoded FMI/TMI id vocabulary.
gaps.gap: No general-purpose, contract-validated intake mechanism for Technical-Lead-supplied MATERIAL (documents, decisions, standards) exists.

gaps.current_state: Evidence model and evidence_catalog already track canonical ids, lineage and snapshots for code-derived evidence.
gaps.gap: Provenance tracking does not yet extend to non-code MATERIAL sources or record who (Technical Lead) authorized incorporation, as required by V4_CONTRACT_FOUNDATION section 2 and 3.5.

gaps.current_state: V3 classifies claims by status (CONFIRMED/INTERPRETED/UNRESOLVED) and by knowledge projection (fact/interpretation/partial/unresolved limitation/ineligible).
gaps.gap: No classification by 'nature' (norma, levantamiento, requerimiento, necesidad, regla de negocio, decisión, arquitectura, proceso, flujo, catálogo, proyecto, resolución, lección, capacitación, glosario, restricción, implementación existente) as required by V4_CONTRACT_FOUNDATION section 5; no MATERIAL->EVIDENCE->INTERPRETATION->PROPOSAL->APPROVED_KNOWLEDGE staged lifecycle.

gaps.current_state: V3 models only what currently exists (as observed in code) plus interpretation/uncertainty states; there is no notion of a desired future state.
gaps.gap: No AS_IS/TO_BE/HISTORICAL temporal dimension exists anywhere in the current data model, per V4_CONTRACT_FOUNDATION section 6.

gaps.current_state: V3 has no concept of comparing a desired state to an observed state.
gaps.gap: No mechanism to detect or represent a GAP (difference between AS_IS and TO_BE) exists; this depends on AS_IS_TO_BE_SEPARATION being implemented first.

gaps.current_state: documentation/consistency.py performs deterministic cross-document consistency checks, but only within the fixed V3 functional/technical document pair and its closed claim vocabulary.
gaps.gap: No general representation of a conflict between two knowledge statements from different sources (with implicated sources, statements, nature, state, evidence, possible cause, human resolution) as required by V4_CONTRACT_FOUNDATION section 7.

gaps.current_state: V3 has no proposal stage; claims move directly from extraction/interpretation to document assessment and human review of the whole document.
gaps.gap: No PROPOSAL entity/lifecycle exists between AI_INTERPRETATION and APPROVED_KNOWLEDGE (V4_CONTRACT_FOUNDATION section 3.2).

gaps.current_state: human_review.py/second_review.py implement a document-level, all-or-nothing approval workflow for a specific closed round with a fixed reviewer role.
gaps.gap: No per-proposal, repeatable approval/rejection/correction workflow tied explicitly to a 'Technical Lead' authority role as the controlled operator (V4_CONTRACT_FOUNDATION section 2).

gaps.current_state: V3 composes context packages (ContextComposer) strictly from code-derived records for LLM consumption, not a canonical multi-source Knowledge Source.
gaps.gap: No mechanism composes approved knowledge from multiple heterogeneous source types into one structured, versionable, traceable Knowledge Source as described in V4_CONTRACT_FOUNDATION section 8.

gaps.current_state: V3 already projects code-derived knowledge deterministically into two fixed Markdown documents (LEVANTAMIENTO_FUNCIONAL/TECNICO) via generator.py/renderer.py.
gaps.gap: Projection logic is hardcoded to those two documents and to code-derived claims; it does not yet project from a general multi-source, multi-nature Knowledge Source, nor produce a Plugin-facing output contract.

out_of_v4_scope_confirmed: Full language/framework/technology/project-layout agnosticism (deferred to V5, per V4_CONTRACT_FOUNDATION section 11).
